headline: Fal raises $1.3B at $16B valuation, led by Bessemer
quote: has raised $1.3 billion in its latest funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Nvidia, Sound Ventures, and T. Rowe Price.
claim: Fal, which hosts and runs AI video, image and audio models, raised $1.3 billion led by Bessemer Venture Partners, valuing it at $16 billion, double its $8 billion valuation in April (per Bloomberg).
why_it_matters: Inference and media-model hosting is drawing very large cheques; infrastructure for serving models is a growing area to build or get hired in.
title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges | TechCrunch

headline: Sequoia raises about $10B and closes London office, Arc and Scouts
quote: The firm has raised roughly $10 billion in new funds, it says.
claim: In a memo titled "The Sequoia of Tomorrow", Sequoia said it raised roughly $10 billion in new funds, is closing its London office, shutting its Arc accelerator and Scouts program, and merging its early-stage and growth teams.
why_it_matters: Two routes for young founders to reach Sequoia (Scouts, Arc) are gone; early-stage funding is concentrating in fewer, larger bets.
title: Sequoia hits rewind, undoing 20 years of expansion | TechCrunch
